patch_description: This crossover keeps the current program’s repaired, diverse starts, archive, and path relinking, while adopting the inspiration program’s exhaustive 2-switch neighborhood and explicit dual-priority move selection. A small number of 3-edge rotations add longer jumps; batches mix dual-ranked, surrogate-ranked, and diverse moves so the search does not rely on a single heuristic. Archive ordering and pruning are made consistent so parent selection can reliably favor strong networks while retaining alternatives.
